title: UI & Leaderboard Dashboard: Next.js App Router, Anti-AI-Slop Dark Mode
description: Implement the full Next.js 15 App Router dashboard with Tailwind CSS v4 dark mode. Build the artist leaderboard, top gainer tracks view, artist detail page with trajectory charts, and responsive shell layout. STRICTLY enforce the Frontend Craft Triad: no AI slop, DHH street aesthetic, data-dense Operate mode, 60fps GPU-only animations, spring physics tactile states.
acceptance_criteria: ANTI-SLOP MANDATORY: No centered hero headlines, no 3-column feature cards, no purple/blue gradient blobs, no generic SaaS template patterns
Dark mode ONLY: High-contrast monochromatic dark palette with amber/industrial accents. Stream numbers lead visual hierarchy.
tailwind.config.ts extends theme with custom dark palette, Inter + JetBrains Mono fonts, and custom spacing scale
src/app/layout.tsx sets dark mode, loads fonts, wraps in Shell component
src/app/page.tsx is the dashboard home — shows scene-wide summary stats, top 5 artists by daily streams, top 5 gainer tracks
src/app/artists/page.tsx renders full ArtistTable leaderboard with sortable columns (daily streams, monthly listeners, delta, followers)
src/app/artists/[id]/page.tsx renders ArtistDetailView with trajectory charts, catalog table, and delta badges
src/app/tracks/page.tsx renders TrackTable with top gainer tracks across the scene
All UI states implemented: Default, Loading (skeleton shimmer), Active, Empty (meaningful empty states), Error (ErrorBoundary with retry)
Components survive stress-test: 1-char artist name 'R' and 100-char unbroken track title without overflow/clipping
All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets
Motion: ONLY transform + opacity animations. scale(0.95)+opacity:0 entry. active:scale-[0.97] press feedback on buttons/cards
Mobile-native: 100dvh, @media(hover:hover) for hover states, responsive breakpoints
DeltaBadge: green for positive, red for negative, neutral for zero, with arrow indicators
Charts use Recharts with dark theme colors matching the palette
Component props match contracts.ts interfaces exactly (ArtistTableProps, TrackTableProps, DeltaBadgeProps, TrajectoryChartProps, DailyStreamChartProps)
